core_obligations: Preserve the full cb-norm and block ordering conventions, original influence definitions and quantitative bound.
Retain complete Haar-unitary/polar-decomposition support and both homogeneous and nonhomogeneous main arguments.
Group root-influence support and direct classical decision-tree consequence with the main theorem, not as separate items.
difficulty_reason: The authors use free-probability norm/trace bounds for random Haar unitaries, then align matrix summands through polar decomposition to lower-bound a completely bounded norm by the sum of root influences. A first-active-block decomposition extends this to nonhomogeneous forms and yields a quantitative influential variable.
